status: Implementation authorized after readiness audit PASS and planning commit publication
subagent_policy: Three implementation bundles covering 21 implementation/evidence-preparation issues (7 issues per implementation agent on average); no recursive delegation. One consolidated independent implementation review later.

bundles.name: delivery-and-operations
owns: selected-owner prep workflow and extracted-service scan disposition

coordinator_owns: root Makefile/dependency integration and cross-bundle interface contract
all GitHub issues/Project/PR operations via gh only
isolated emulation/integration runtime ownership and final local checks
bundle merges, independent consolidated review, source/evidence ledger, worklog and final HTML
safety: No real AWS network/API/CLI/account operation, deployment or spend
No Alibaba operations; no private credential dumps
Preserve existing root demo and frozen historical worktrees/volumes
Only coordinator starts isolated containers/emulators; workers use pure offline checks
Existing cloud acceptance criteria remain unexecuted; implement runnable prep protocols/harnesses and record future gates separately
No mandatory controller/launch table/OIDC/paid service or frontend redesign

emulator.localstack: No supplied activation token; no account/license created
emulator.fallback: Moto5.2.4 loopback server plus isolated local service checks; neither proves Fargate/CloudFront/real IAM/billing

inter_bundle_contract.shared_config: Explicit nonsecret region/account/environment/resource IDs, HTTPS public origin, buckets, digest/task family/service mapping, approved operator station and session deadlines; missing approval blocks live operations
inter_bundle_contract.transport: Injectable call(service, operation, payload, deadline) returning dict; AWS CLI production planner is future/gated, emulator execution accepts loopback endpoints + dummy credentials only
inter_bundle_contract.evidence: Selected fields only; public output capabilities/DSNs/cookies/origin-header/SSM values never persist; private state is separate
inter_bundle_contract.services: media, processing_api, processing_recovery; worker and owner migrations are standalone families
inter_bundle_contract.worker: Maximum3 nonterminal + unresolved launches; single control station; private journal before launch; task/RQ identity; finite cloud lifetime; warm drain before force stop
inter_bundle_contract.readiness: TCP/owned schema/Redis/private peer checks beyond liveness; no worker required to leave API online
inter_bundle_contract.exports: Common quiescent proof hook from environment lifecycle, private owner DB/roles export manifest; failure blocks backup claim/destructive teardown

branches_are_isolated: Each child works in its assigned new local worktree; child commits only its bundle. Coordinator creates/links/reviews/merges PRs via gh into work/aws2-prep-20261015.
